title: security/explain: sets a position grants through its definition's permissionSets are attributed "via direct grant", not to the position
body:
Filing class: defect (operator-visible diagnostics; effective access is correct) — reach: `POST /api/v1/security/explain`, measured on `@objectstack/*` 18.1.0 in objectstack-ai/hotclm (`main` `f5ad133`, report on objectstack-ai/hotclm#11).

## Symptom
A user who holds a position whose definition names its sets in `permissionSets: [...]` (ADR-0131 D3 shape) and has **no** `sys_user_permission_set` row gets an `explain` principal whose contributors read **`via: direct grant`** for those sets. Only a set whose name equals the position's own name reads `position:<name>`.

Measured: hotclm position `clm_legal_counsel` declares `permissionSets: ['clm_legal', 'clm_requester']`; a user with only that `sys_user_position` row → explain principal contributors `clm_legal` via *direct grant*, `clm_requester` via *direct grant*. Same for the finance, records and executive positions. A `clm_admin` position (same-named set) → `position:clm_admin`.

## Expected
Contributors name the position that granted them (`position:clm_legal_counsel`), so an operator reading explain can tell an assignment row from a position definition — the distinction #24757 also needs in Setup.

## Repro
1. A position with `permissionSets: ['set_a']` where `set_a` ≠ the position name.
2. Assign a user only that position (no `sys_user_permission_set` row).
3. `POST /api/v1/security/explain` as or for that user → contributor `set_a` reads `via: direct grant`.

Effective access is correct (the sets are in force); only the attribution is wrong. Seam: `plugin-security` explain principal contributor attribution for position-defined sets. Related: #24757 (same-named set invisible in Setup), #24736 (position walk counting).

---
_Filed by the objectstack-ai/hotclm PM seat from the hotclm#11 dev report._
